reason: The triclinic cell, Z=1, and layered/distorted-spinel average framework are strongly supported by the peak positions, and the submitted bond lengths and density are physically plausible. Exact recovery is not sufficiently established, however: the comparable whole-pattern Rwp is unavailable, the custom profile fit retains systematic intensity residuals (including the weak 19.06 degree ordering-sensitive line), and the trajectory fixed one full-occupancy Li/vacancy realization derived from a disordered reference while refining mainly the oxygen coordinates. It did not instantiate and compare explicit competing Li/vacancy occupancy or ordered-supercell models, so support for the submitted P-1 coordinates, full occupancies, and element/vacancy ordering is materially weaker than support for the cell and framework. Another attempt is warranted to resolve or cover that discrete ordering ambiguity with comparable whole-pattern fits.
